_migrations.reason: Phase 1.2 cost gate switched from LINEAR (scalp ≥ cost × hurdle) to CUBE-ROOT (scalp ≥ cost × hurdle^(1/3)). The original tuned value 1.3624 expected the linear gate; under cube-root the effective threshold would have dropped to 1.36^(1/3) ≈ 1.11× cost — much looser than the tuned optimum. Migrated to 1.3624^3 = 2.5288 so the new cube-root gate produces the same effective threshold the optimizer found. Re-run autoresearch on captured tape to find the true Phase 1.2 optimum.
